description: This source file contains a Go test suite for testing the powerwash functionality of Android devices using the Cuttlefish emulator. It sets up a device environment, performs operations such as creating files via ADB, and checks the device state post-powerwash to verify the clean-up process.

classes.name: hoapi.CVD
classes.description: Represents a containerized virtual device used in Cuttlefish testing.

methods.name: TestPowerwash
methods.description: Main test function that initializes the environment, performs powerwash, and verifies that temporary files are removed post-operation.

methods.name: createDevice
methods.description: Helper function to set up a device with necessary artifacts and configurations before testing.
